settings.title: Cost Tracking Settings
settings.description: Configure cost discounts and margins for different LLM providers. Changes are saved automatically.

providerDiscounts.title: Provider Discounts
providerDiscounts.description: Apply percentage-based discounts to reduce costs for specific providers
providerDiscounts.emptyHint: Click "Add Provider Discount" to get started

margin.title: Fee/Price Margin
margin.description: Add fees or margins to LLM costs for internal billing and cost recovery
margin.emptyHint: Click "Add Provider Margin" to get started

blockUnpriced.title: Block Unpriced Models
blockUnpriced.description: Reject requests for models that have no pricing in the cost map instead of logging them as ￥0 spend
blockUnpriced.label: Block requests for models without pricing
blockUnpriced.hint: When enabled, a request whose resolved model has no cost mapping is rejected with a 403 so an admin can add pricing for it. Off by default

holidaySection.title: Off-peak Holiday Calendar
holidaySection.description: Review official annual holiday notices and confirm dates used by time-based model pricing

addProviderDialog.title: Add Provider Discount
addProviderDialog.description: Select a provider and set its discount percentage. Enter a value between 0% and 100% (e.g., 5 for a 5% discount).

addMarginDialog.title: Add Provider Margin
addMarginDialog.description: Select a provider (or "Global" for all providers) and configure the margin. You can use percentage-based or fixed amount.

addProvider.providerHint: Select the LLM provider you want to configure a discount for
addProvider.modelPatternHint: Leave empty to discount every model from this provider. Use a glob such as claude-* or gemini-2* to discount only matching models
addProvider.discountHint: Enter a percentage value (e.g., 5 for 5% discount)

addMargin.providerHint: Select 'Global' to apply margin to all providers, or select a specific provider
addMargin.marginTypeHint: Choose how to apply the margin: percentage-based or fixed amount
addMargin.marginHint: Enter a percentage value (e.g., 10 for 10% margin)
addMargin.fixedHint: Enter a fixed amount in CNY (e.g., 0.001 for ￥0.001 per request)
